h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chinsurah

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chinsurah

items.pText: Chinsurah, on the west bank of the Hooghly, was once a Dutch trading settlement and is now the headquarters of Hooghly district. Some of its schools and colleges sit on old campuses with large trees and heritage buildings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and supplies schools, residential complexes, clubs and municipal parks in Chinsurah and nearby towns.

Old campuses bring their own planning questions. Big trees give welcome shade in the humid Bengal summer, but their roots and falling branches need thought. Heritage buildings mean a school may not want bright, loud colours right beside an old facade. We plan the play area around existing trees, and with 15+ roto-moulded shades available, we can suggest softer colour combinations that sit comfortably next to older buildings.

richText.heading: Planning play equipment around old trees

c: Keep footings outside the main root zone of large trees, which usually spreads well beyond the trunk. Check overhead for dead branches before you fix the layout, and keep swings out from under heavy limbs.

Leaves and fruit drop through the year here, so plan a weekly sweep of the rubber flooring and the slide beds. The shade means less heat on the equipment, but more damp, so scrub slides in the monsoon. Garden pieces like the

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed under large trees?
items.a: Yes, with care. Keep footings clear of the main roots, check for dead branches overhead and keep swings away from heavy limbs. We plan positions from your site photos.

items.q: Can you suggest colours that suit a heritage campus?
items.a: Yes. With 15+ roto-moulded shades, we can suggest softer combinations such as greens and beiges that sit well beside older buildings. Share photos of the campus.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Hooghly district?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai by road and install it in Chinsurah and nearby towns with our team or a West Bengal dealer.
